ModMetaData.name: Rhyaeth WDI Realistic Bodies Patch
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A small compatibility patch: the Rhy'aeth xenotype of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3707527452]Erin's Rhy'aeth[/url] wears the scaly body textures of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3527486510]WDI's Realistic Bodies[/url] (the ScalySkin set), body type by body type: Female, Male, Thin, Hulk, Fat and Child. Babies keep Erin's own swaddled-baby texture, since WDI ships none.
IF I GO QUIET
If I do not answer within a reasonable time after being contacted, anyone may freely update this or any other of my mods, including publishing a continuation of it. All credit must be preserved.
AI-GENERATED
This mod was made with Claude Code (Anthropic) under human direction, review and testing. Stated openly: working with these tools is my job.
THANKS
Erin and Haru'a for Rhy'aeth. Windonsi and Starkz for WDI's Realistic Bodies, whose textures this patch only points at: none is copied here.
[url=https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Rhyaeth-WDI-Realistic-Bodies-Patch]Source code on GitHub[/url]
